title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Test 1 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
scenario: The first table below shows changes in the total population of New York City from 1800 to 2000. The second and third tables show changes in the population of the five districts of the city (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Bronx, Queens, Staten Island) over the same period.

visualData.title: New York City population, 1800 to 2000
labels: Other districts (Brooklyn, Bronx, Queens, Staten Island)
notes: The Manhattan and other-district tables divide the total population into Manhattan and the combined populations of Brooklyn, Bronx, Queens and Staten Island.
